# Review-copy watermark on the launch film

The Magnifito launch film as a client review copy: a dark banner reading "REVIEW COPY" with the reviewer's name is burned into the top-right corner of every frame, so a shared cut cannot pass as the final.

- Type: Review watermark
- Skill: `magnifito-edit`
- Engine: `watermark`
- Output: 1920x1080, 15 s, with audio
- Video: [`../videos/f19-review-watermark.mp4`](../videos/f19-review-watermark.mp4)

## Recreate it with Claude Code

Install the plugin (see the repository README), open this folder, and give Claude this prompt:

> Make a review copy of ../videos/01-branded-promo.mp4 for the client: burn in a "REVIEW COPY" watermark with the reviewer name "Magnifito client" in the top-right corner, clear of the titles. Keep the sound.

## Recreate it by hand

From the repository root, one command renders this example exactly as committed:

```sh
npm run showcase -- f19-review-watermark
```

Or run the steps yourself from `showcase/f19-review-watermark/` (after `npm run build && npm link`):

```sh
mgvideo watermark ../videos/01-branded-promo.mp4 --text 'REVIEW COPY' --reviewer 'Magnifito client' --position top_right --out work/review-copy.mp4
```

The finished file is `work/review-copy.mp4`. The config files in this folder are the inputs.
